85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:1.name: Child 1
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:1.text: DAD!! I'm so glad to see you!

answers.text: My dear daughter! There you are
I'm also pretty happy to see you
You're alive! But where are your siblings?

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:2.name: I want to go home
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:2.text: I really want to go home now. I miss our cat

answers.text: Are you sure you can go alone?
Lord Whiskers is waiting for you at home
I was going to make tacos tonight
Would it be ok for you to go home alone?

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:4.text: Timmy dared us to go down that creepy stairway! The others went further down...

answers.text: Classic Timmy.. I have to find them
I told you not to play in the old garden

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:5.name: I'm sorry
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:5.text: I'm sorry dad.. I really want to go home now!

answers.text: I will show you the way back but you have to go alone
I have to find the others. Do you have any idea where the next staircase is?

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:6.name: I will go alone
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:6.text: I will go alone! I'm scared but I'm also hungry as hell!

answers.text: Ok, I will see you at home

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:7.name: Staircase
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:7.text: I think the staircase is to the @STAIRCASE_HEADING of here. Can you show me the way out of here now please??

answers.text: I can show you the way but you will have to go alone

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:9.name: Lord Whiskers
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:9.text: He's a lazy fat cat but I love him.

answers.text: Ok I can tell you the way home but you'll have to go alone

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:10.name: I can start cooking
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:10.text: TACOS! I can go home and start cooking so you can concentrate on finding the rest.

answers.text: Ok, I will show you the way, but you'll have to go alone

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:11.name: Child 2
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:11.text: Well hello dad! Why are you lurking around here?

answers.text: I'm looking for my missing kids
Well hello Theodore! Glad to see you're alive
I have been worried sick about you!

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:12.text: Well here I am at least! We got split up.. there was a fight.

answers.text: Oh you are fighting.. what a surprise
You should head back home

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:13.name: Don't worry
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:13.text: Don't worry about me! I can always manage.

answers.text: I'm sure. But now it's time to go home
You have always been the brave one

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:14.name: I explored
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:14.text: I explored this whole floor. Lot's of weird creatures living here! I tried communicating with them but they are not that friendly.

answers.text: So did you find anything else?
You should go home now

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:15.name: But this is exciting
85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:15.text: But this is so exciting! I love it here

85E70DC7-51D8-47B4-9820-866D12F367A4:16.text: Ok I'll go, show me the way up please.
